```{r plot_variant_sites, fig.width=12, fig.height=7, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

# 1. Load data files
counts_df <- read_csv("D://git_hub/TARVa/TARVaCreation/AnalysisSet1/sample_site_counts_per_variant.csv")
pval_df <- read_csv("D://git_hub/TARVa/TARVaCreation/AnalysisSet1/global_set_calltype_pvalues.csv")

# Replace "Control" with "CN" and update edit type labels (A-I -> A-G, C-U -> C-T)
counts_df <- counts_df %>%
  mutate(
    condition = if_else(condition == "Control", "CN", condition),
    variant_call = case_when(
      variant_call == "A-I" ~ "A-G",
      variant_call == "C-U" ~ "C-T",
      TRUE                  ~ variant_call
    )
  )

pval_df <- pval_df %>%
  mutate(
    variant_call_type = case_when(
      variant_call_type == "A-I" ~ "A-G",
      variant_call_type == "C-U" ~ "C-T",
      TRUE                       ~ variant_call_type
    )
  )

# 2. Assign significance stars based on adjusted p-values
pval_df <- pval_df %>%
  mutate(
    sig_label = case_when(
      adj_pvalue < 0.001 ~ "***",
      adj_pvalue < 0.01  ~ "**",
      adj_pvalue < 0.05  ~ "*"
    ),
    effect_label = sprintf("r = %.2f", rbc)
  )

# 3. Define custom alphabetical factor order: Nucleotides first, then del, then ins
nuc_types <- sort(setdiff(unique(counts_df$variant_call), c("del", "ins")))
custom_order <- c(nuc_types, "del", "ins")

# Apply factor levels to counts_df
counts_df <- counts_df %>%
  filter(variant_call %in% custom_order) %>%
  mutate(variant_call = factor(variant_call, levels = custom_order))

# Calculate y-axis positions for significance annotations
plot_range <- max(counts_df$`total sites`, na.rm = TRUE) - min(counts_df$`total sites`, na.rm = TRUE)

y_max_df <- counts_df %>%
  group_by(variant_call) %>%
  summarize(y_top = max(`total sites`, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  inner_join(pval_df %>% rename(variant_call = variant_call_type), by = "variant_call") %>%
  mutate(
    y_pos_sig = y_top + plot_range * 0.10,
    y_pos_effect = y_top + plot_range * 0.03
  )

# 4. Colorblind-friendly Palette (Okabe-Ito: CN = Blue, AD = Vermillion)
cb_palette <- c("CN" = "#56B4E9", "AD" = "#D55E00")

# 5. Generate Plot
p <- ggplot(counts_df, aes(x = variant_call, y = `total sites`, fill = condition)) +
  # Boxplots
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA, 
    alpha = 0.65, 
    color = "black", 
    width = 0.7, 
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
  ) +
  # Overlay scatter points (Darker points with jitter to stand out clearly over boxplots)
  geom_point(
    aes(color = condition),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8),
    size = 1.8, 
    alpha = 0.9, 
    stroke = 0.3
  ) +
  # Significance annotations (*, **, ***)
  geom_text(
    data = y_max_df,
    aes(x = variant_call, y = y_pos_sig, label = sig_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 6.5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  # Effect size annotations (rbc) shown at every x-position regardless of significance
  geom_text(
    data = y_max_df,
    aes(x = variant_call, y = y_pos_effect, label = effect_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "italic",
    color = "gray30"
  ) +
  # Custom Colors
  scale_fill_manual(values = cb_palette) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CN" = "#0072B2", "AD" = "#990000")) +
  # Formatting & Labels
  labs(
    x = "Variant Call Type",
    y = "Total Sites (per Sample)",
    fill = "Condition"
  ) +
  guides(color = "none") + # Hide duplicate color legend for scatter points
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.18)))



# Save plot directly to high-res PNG
ggsave(
  filename = "D://FunkLab/Writing/ROSMAP_2026/ROSMAP_FrontiersGenetics_NeurogenomicsCall/Fig3_boxplot_260818.tiff",
  plot = p,
  width = 12,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300,
  units = "in"
)
```
